references.text: The Israelites were to camp each by their own banner, under the signs of their ancestral houses, around the Tent of Meeting.
The Israelites did all that the Lord commanded Moses. So they camped by their banners and broke camp, each according to their clans and ancestral houses.
Balaam saw Israel camped tribe by tribe, and the Spirit of God came upon him.
Describes how the tribes of Israel broke camp and marched in orderly divisions according to their banners.
Moses organized the people into groups with leaders over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens—a military organization that reflects the army structure.
